NOTES wrote:


▣ Source Comparison || Screenshot Comparison

▣ GBR BD has better PQ and grain than all the other sources, so GBR BD was chosen. The main audio tracks in JPN BD and GBR BD were similar in listening experience. According to spectrogram analysis, JPN seems to have more information than GBR BD. So. took the main audio from JPN BD. The main audio and film scholar commentary were dual-mono, which were converted to 16-bit FLAC 1.0 channels. 2nd commentary was stereoized mono, so it was just converted to 16-bit FLAC 2.0 channels.

Quote


sox dualmono.flac -n remix 1,2v-1 spectrogram -x 10000 -y 1025 -z 120 -o mono.png -c "Dual.Mono"

▣ GBR BD English subtitle was OCR'ed, spell-checked & formatted by me. Simplified Chinese subtitles from SubHD (thanks 电影传送门!), Traditional Chinese subtitles translated from the Simplified one (thanks 繁化姬!), French subtitles from iyohm (thanks!), Romanian subtitles from Dappon (thanks! / which was manually synced to the source), and the rest of the subtitles from BDs, PAL DVD and WEB-DL and synced.

▣ There were chapter names present in two sources, JPN BD (translated by Rocchio@User) & BFI DVD, though JPN BD had more chapters but they had major spoilers, so BFI DVD chapters were chosen, and changed to I-frames.

▣ Thanks to the uploaders for the sources. Greetings to everyone. Enjoy!
